zh.title: 邑昇桃園龜山二期新廠啟用 擴充無人機與航太高階PCB產能
zh.summary: 邑昇實業啟用桃園龜山二期新廠；提升無人機與航太高階PCB產能；鉅橡推進建廠
body: 印刷電路板（PCB）製造商邑昇實業近期宣布，其部位於桃園龜山擴建的二期廠房已正式啟用。隨著高頻高速與高散熱等高階電路板需求上升，該公司透過引進高階生產設備、自動化搬運及數位化製程管理，全面提升高層數、高精密、高頻高速及厚銅等利基型產品產能，預計二期新廠月產能可增加至原有產能的1.5倍。
邑昇實業表示，公司近年持續優化產品組合並聚焦高附加價值市場，產品應用領域涵蓋人工智慧（AI）伺服器、資料中心、工業電腦、車用電子及無人機等範疇，並積極擴展低軌衛星與航太軍工市場。其中，航太衛星及無人機產品對印刷電路板在耐環境性、高可靠度、精密度以及產品可追溯性等方面皆提出更嚴格的規格需求。
面對高頻高速基板與特殊銅箔等關鍵原材料需求大幅增加，加上近期材料價格上揚、供應吃緊與交期拉長等挑戰，邑昇表示將採取「多元取得、掌握需求、快速替代」三項策略，藉此強化供應鏈韌性，並有效調控缺料風險、交期時程與單一供應來源之風險。
另一方面，絕緣材料廠鉅橡受惠於台灣與中國大陸昆山兩地印刷電路板客戶拉貨力道增加，帶動高階墊板與銅箔基板（CCL）相關包裝材料出貨穩定成長。鉅橡指出，人工智慧與高效能運算需求正逐步延伸至無人機、電動車、機器人及工業自動化等新興領域，公司正積極推進新廠建置計畫，並配合客戶備貨需求調整產能配置，持續提高高階產品出貨比重。

en.title: Esing Opens Taoyuan Guishan Phase 2 Plant to Boost High-End PCB Capacity for Drones and Aerospace
en.summary: Esing Real Enterprise opens Taoyuan Guishan plant; expands drone PCB capacity; Ju Oak plans new facility
body: Printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturer Esing Real Enterprise has announced the activation of its expanded phase two production facility in Guishan, Taoyuan. To meet growing market demand for high-speed, high-density, and high-heat-dissipation specifications, the company has introduced advanced production equipment, automated material handling, and digitized process management. The expansion targets niche PCB products including high-layer, high-precision, high-frequency, high-speed, and heavy copper boards, boosting the new facility's monthly capacity to 1.5 times its original volume.

Esing stated that it continues to shift its product portfolio toward high-value applications, focusing on markets such as artificial intelligence (AI) servers, data centers, industrial PCs, automotive electronics, and unmanned aerial vehicles (drones). The company is also expanding into low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellites and aerospace defense applications. The firm noted that aerospace satellite and drone products require higher standards in environmental resistance, reliability, precision, and product traceability.

Amid rising demand for key materials such as high-frequency substrates and special copper foils, as well as challenges from material price increases, tight supply, and extended lead times, Esing outlined a strategy based on diversified procurement, demand tracking, and rapid substitution. This approach aims to strengthen supply chain resilience and mitigate risks related to material shortages, delivery delays, and reliance on single suppliers.

Separately, insulation material manufacturer Ju Oak reported growing shipments of high-end backing boards and copper-clad laminate (CCL) packaging materials, driven by demand from PCB clients in Taiwan and Kunshan, China. Ju Oak noted that demand driven by AI and high-performance computing is extending into emerging sectors including drones, electric vehicles, robotics, and industrial automation. The company is advancing its new plant construction plans while adjusting production capacity to support customer stocking needs and raise the proportion of high-end product shipments.

zh.title: 立院無人機條例26日再協商 民眾黨主張一般條例編常規預算
zh.summary: 立法院26日重啟無人機條例協商；民眾黨主張一般條例由年度預算支應
body: 台灣立法院黨團預計於2026年8月26日下午，針對無人載具條例草案重新進行朝野黨團協商。民眾黨立法院黨團於8月24日舉行記者會表示，黨團將持續堅持自身提出的草案版本，並強調該版本經由黨內充分討論，能健全國內無人機產業發展與軍用採購規範。
針對草案預算編列爭議，民眾黨團說明，其版本屬於一般條例而非特別條例，因此未在法案內直接明列預算金額上限，主張應透過政府常規性的年度預算進行編列。此外，民眾黨版草案主張設立無人機戰略發展委員會，用以建立長期發展規劃並作為年度預算編列之指引。
立法院先前於8月20日曾就無人載具條例草案舉行朝野協商，當時因各黨團對法案名稱、主管機關及經費上限等關鍵條文未能達成共識，會議主席隨後宣告全案保留。

en.title: Taiwan Lawmakers to Resume Drone Act Talks August 26 as TPP Pushes General Statute
en.summary: Taiwan lawmakers will hold cross-party talks August 26 on the drone bill amid TPP budget framework proposals.
body: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan caucuses are scheduled to hold cross-party negotiations on the draft Unmanned Vehicle Act on August 26, 2026. The Taiwan People's Party (TPP) caucus announced at an August 24 press conference that it will maintain its proposed bill version, stating that its statute framework supports domestic drone industry development and procurement.

Addressing budget provisions, the TPP caucus explained that its version is drafted as a general statute rather than a special statute, thereby omitting a fixed total expenditure cap. The party advocated funding drone procurement and research through regular annual government budgets, accompanied by a proposed Drone Strategic Development Committee to guide long-term planning and annual budget formulation.

Lawmakers previously convened cross-party talks on August 20 regarding the unmanned vehicle legislation. However, negotiations ended without agreement due to differences over the statutory title, governing authority, budget caps, and implementation timelines, leaving the bill retained for further deliberation.
